stories.title: Navantia entrega de tapadillo un barco de guerra a la Marina Real de Marruecos

en.title: Navantia quietly delivers warship to Morocco's Royal Navy
en.summary: Spanish shipbuilder Navantia delivered the patrol vessel Moulay Hassan I to Morocco's Royal Navy in a low-key administrative ceremony without officials or guests, amid growing bilateral tensions over immigration issues.

stories.title: Un preso de la cárcel Mas d'Enric (Tarragona) condenado por asesinato se fuga durante una salida programada

en.title: Prisoner convicted of murder escapes from Mas d'Enric prison in Tarragona during scheduled outing
en.summary: A prisoner serving time for murder escaped from a Tarragona prison while participating in an authorized group activity that included a meal stop at a restaurant.

stories.title: Encuentran muerto a Nicholas Brandram, sospechoso del 'caso Putney Pusher'

en.title: Nicholas Brandram, suspect in 'Putney Pusher' case, found dead
en.summary: Nicholas Brandram, a descendant of Queen Victoria and suspect in the Putney Pusher case, was found dead. He had previously been detained on drug possession allegations.

stories.title: TVE se queda sin ‘Masterchef Junior’, que pasará a Disney+

en.title: TVE loses 'Masterchef Junior' as show moves to Disney+
en.summary: The twelfth season of the cooking competition series featuring child contestants will no longer air on traditional television and is moving to the Disney+ streaming platform.

stories.title: La venta del ático de Chamberí que compró la Comunidad de Madrid queda desierta tras no recibir ninguna oferta

en.title: Sale of Chamberí penthouse purchased by Madrid Regional Government remains vacant after receiving no offers
en.summary: The Madrid Regional Government received no bids for a penthouse listed at 6.7 million euros, resulting in the auction being declared void. The property will now be offered for sale indefinitely without a bidding deadline.

stories.title: ¿Cómo puede ser Canadá un Estado Miembro Asociado de la UE?

en.title: How can Canada become an EU Associated Member State?
en.summary: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen and Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney have proposed making Canada the first EU Associated Member State, presented as an ambitious foreign policy initiative amid geopolitical uncertainty and trade tensions.

stories.title: «Se le ha gestionado que pudiera aparcar en Ferraz»: la declaración que demuestra el acceso libre de Leire a la sede del PSOE

en.title: "She was allowed to park at Ferraz": the statement proving Leire's free access to PSOE headquarters
en.summary: A party worker testified that Leire Díez, a figure under investigation in an alleged PSOE espionage scandal, had access to the socialist headquarters' parking for meetings with organization secretary Santos Cerdán.

stories.title: La Reina Letizia vuelve a su colegio de Oviedo para inaugurar el curso escolar: reencuentro con sus profesoras y clases de yoga

en.title: Queen Letizia returns to her school in Oviedo to inaugurate the school year: reunion with teachers and yoga classes
en.summary: Queen Letizia visited her childhood school in Oviedo where she studied, reuniting with former teachers and participating in school year inauguration activities.

stories.title: La subasta por el ático de Ayuso queda desierta por falta de ofertas

en.title: Auction for Ayuso's penthouse remains empty due to lack of offers
en.summary: A penthouse in Madrid's Chamberí neighbourhood with a starting price of 6.694.201 euros failed to attract any bidders at auction.

stories.title: El polémico ático se queda sin comprador y la Comunidad de Madrid muestra con documentos que no se adquirió para "residencia oficial" de Ayuso

en.title: Disputed penthouse remains unsold as Madrid Community documents it was not acquired as Ayuso's official residence
en.summary: Madrid's regional government released documents claiming the penthouse was intended as a workplace and occasional accommodation for visiting officials rather than as an official residence for the regional leader.

stories.title: La reina Letizia vuelve al colegio de su infancia en Oviedo para inaugurar el curso escolar

en.title: Queen Letizia returns to her childhood school in Oviedo to inaugurate the school year
en.summary: Queen Letizia visited the public school La Gesta in Oviedo, where she studied for seven years, to inaugurate the academic year.

stories.title: Letizia vuelve cuarenta años después al colegio público de su infancia

en.title: Letizia returns forty years later to her childhood public school
en.summary: Queen Letizia visited her elementary school after four decades, reuniting with some of her former teachers.

en.summary: The article discusses issues related to citizenship policies.

stories.title: Sánchez ofrece la paz a los empresarios y acudirá a su gran cumbre en Madrid

en.title: Sánchez offers peace to businesspeople and will attend their major summit in Madrid
en.summary: Spain's Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez plans to attend the October 5 opening of the annual Family Business Institute congress, the largest business organization gathering in Spain.

stories.title: La SEC da vía libre a la negociación de 'criptoacciones' en Wall Street

en.title: SEC clears the way for trading of 'crypto stocks' on Wall Street
en.summary: The U.S. market regulator issued an exemption allowing the trading of tokenized stocks for a five-year period.

stories.title: Santander comienza a negociar un ERE en sus filiales tecnológicas

en.title: Santander begins negotiating a restructuring plan in its technology subsidiaries
en.summary: Santander has initiated negotiations for workforce restructuring at its technology units Santander Digital Services and Gravity, citing technical and organizational reasons for the changes.

stories.title: Trump ve un "acto hostil" en la alianza UE-Canadá y amenaza con "severos aranceles" a Europa

en.title: Trump sees a "hostile act" in EU-Canada alliance and threatens "severe tariffs" on Europe
en.summary: The U.S. president has threatened to impose new tariffs and potentially sever commercial ties with the European Union if it grants Canada associate membership status.
